The ticket number is **#88412**. I've posted that as a reply to Hollis's message in #central-random.

It's the Tier 2 escalation for the Tansleigh Packaging gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the bill-of-lading (BOL) barcode scan. Tobias raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. He first wrote "TP," then confirmed he meant Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.

I found it in GBrain and checked it against #central-team, which Hollis is in, so this is something they could see themselves. Ticket numbers are operational facts, so it was fine to post in the channel. I didn't find any newer ticket for this issue in that channel.
